description: Defines kernel registration macros and functions for creating empty tensors based on existing tensors in the torch::nativert namespace.

classes.name: OpKernel_##id
classes.description: Kernel class generated by registration macros for CPU kernels.

methods.name: create_empty_from
methods.description: Creates an empty tensor based on the properties of an existing tensor, with optional overrides for dtype, device, layout, or memory format.
